name: Sun Is Dead
detailed_description:
The sun has died. The world is drowning in darkness. You are the last ember of hope.

In Sun is Dead, a fast-paced, action-packed scavenger adventure, you play as a lone survivor navigating the ruins of a world swallowed by eternal night. The longer you linger, the stronger the Shadows become—monstrous entities that thrive in the absence of light. Keep moving, adapt your tactics, and fight to uncover the truth behind the world’s collapse.

KEY FEATURES

🔥 Survive the Darkness – Stay too long in one place, and the Shadows will evolve, forcing you to stay on the move and think strategically.

⚔ Tactical, High-Speed Combat – Master a dynamic mix of melee and ranged weapons, chaining attacks, dodges, and finishers to take down relentless enemies. Every fight is a test of skill and adaptability.

🗡 Wield the Last Light – A dying angel entrusts you with a relic weapon capable of cutting through the darkness. Upgrade and customize it to suit your playstyle, from swift, precise strikes to devastating heavy blows.

🌎 Explore a Doomed World – Traverse the remains of civilization, from ruined cities to forgotten sanctuaries. Uncover lost knowledge and face horrors lurking in the abyss.

🎭 Unravel the Mystery – The sun was not merely extinguished—it was taken. Your journey will reveal the forces that led to the eternal night and test your resolve to bring back the light.

💀 Adapt or Perish – The longer you survive, the more the world fights back. The Shadows do not wait. They hunt.

Will you be the one to reignite the sun? Or will you be swallowed by the dark?

Game is being developed by 1 person, therefore any support is greatly appreciated :)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 20H2)
  • Processor: Six-Core Xeon E5-2643 @ 3.4GHz
  • Memory: 64 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
